description_en: Deletes an AccessKey pair for an Alibaba Cloud account or a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 删除阿里云账号（主账号）或RAM用户的访问密钥
kebab_example: aliyun ims delete-access-key --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAccessKey

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AccessKey pair that you want to delete
parameters.name: user_access_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The logon name of the RAM user.

If this parameter is empty, the AccessKey pair of the current user is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

如果为空，默认删除当前用户的访问密钥
parameters.name: user_principal_name
